p.src: Two people may use the same phrase and live inside very different calendars. For one person, ten years is the minimum unit of patience. For another, three years is already a long time. For a person with better skill, better strategy, and a steady source of new capital, the same long term becomes much shorter.

p.src: If you are surrounded by people who read carefully, build spreadsheets, test ideas, write notes, calculate risk, and improve their earning power, their existence becomes a challenge. Older learners may be awakened by the seriousness of newer learners. Newer learners may be pushed forward by those who began earlier. The comparison does not have to become envy. It can become evidence that more is possible.

p.src: Choose the peer group carefully. Then let the pressure do some useful work.

u.src: Choose the peer group carefully. Then let the pressure do some useful work.

p.src: The same principle applies to this whole path. We are not merely readers collecting ideas. We are people trying to change our relationship with attention, capital, work, time, and freedom. That requires a kind of companionship, even if the work is done alone at a desk.

p.src: Calculate Your Own Long Term

u.src: Calculate Your Own Long Term
en: Calculate Your Own Long Term

p.src: The word long term should no longer remain vague.

u.src: The word long term should no longer remain vague.
en: The word long term should no longer remain vague.

p.src: Ask yourself four questions:

u.src: Ask yourself four questions:
en: Ask yourself four questions:

p.src: At what annual compound return can I realistically invest now?

u.src: At what annual compound return can I realistically invest now?
en: At what annual compound return can I realistically invest now?

p.src: How much can I improve that return through study, selection, and better decision-making?

u.src: How much can I improve that return through study, selection, and better decision-making?
en: How much can I improve that return through study, selection, and better decision-making?

p.src: How much new capital can I add regularly from income outside investing?

u.src: How much new capital can I add regularly from income outside investing?
en: How much new capital can I add regularly from income outside investing?

p.src: How much drag do my spending needs impose on the compounding process?

u.src: How much drag do my spending needs impose on the compounding process?
en: How much drag do my spending needs impose on the compounding process?

p.src: Then calculate.

u.src: Then calculate.
en: Then calculate.

p.src: Do not calculate once and worship the result. Recalculate as your ability changes. Recalculate as your income changes. Recalculate as your understanding of risk improves. Recalculate when your assumptions become more honest.

u.src: Do not calculate once and worship the result. Recalculate as your ability changes. Recalculate as your income changes. Recalculate as your understanding of risk improves. Recalculate when your assumptions become more honest.
en: Do not calculate once and worship the result. Recalculate as your ability changes. Recalculate as your income changes. Recalculate as your understanding of risk improves. Recalculate when your assumptions become more honest.

p.src: The purpose is not to predict the future perfectly. The purpose is to stop treating the future as fog. Even a rough calculation is better than a vague mood.

u.src: The purpose is not to predict the future perfectly. The purpose is to stop treating the future as fog. Even a rough calculation is better than a vague mood.
en: The purpose is not to predict the future perfectly. The purpose is to stop treating the future as fog. Even a rough calculation is better than a vague mood.

p.src: The chapter can be summarized in three sentences:

u.src: The chapter can be summarized in three sentences:
en: The chapter can be summarized in three sentences:

p.src: For the more capable person, long term is shorter. For the person with a correct strategy, long term is shorter. For the person with income outside investing, long term is shorter.

u.src: For the more capable person, long term is shorter. For the person with a correct strategy, long term is shorter. For the person with income outside investing, long term is shorter.
en: For the more capable person, long term is shorter. For the person with a correct strategy, long term is shorter. For the person with income outside investing, long term is shorter.

p.src: The reverse is also true. Weak ability lengthens the road. No strategy lengthens the road. Forced withdrawals lengthen the road.

u.src: The reverse is also true. Weak ability lengthens the road. No strategy lengthens the road. Forced withdrawals lengthen the road.
en: The reverse is also true. Weak ability lengthens the road. No strategy lengthens the road. Forced withdrawals lengthen the road.

p.src: Therefore the practical command is clear: keep learning, keep earning, keep calculating, and keep adding capital to the right things. Long term is not only something you endure. It is something you can reshape.
